evidence: gene region (association markers in and near the gene; not a SNP)
effect: adult migration (run) timing in steelhead: summer (premature) or winter (mature) run; the markers explained 46% of the variation in one coastal population (Hess 2016) and far less in inland steelhead (Willis 2020)
caveat: not a SNP: the gene region 28:12029722-12109046 (Ensembl 116; unnamed there, GREB1L by its human ortholog). The published markers were mapped on other assemblies and are not placed on USDA_OmykA_1.1
note: Hess 2016: three SNPs in a 46 kb region overlapping GREB1-like; Prince 2017: the same locus in steelhead and Chinook salmon; Willis 2020: chromosome 28 markers (GREB1L, ROCK1)
